name: @pipeworx/mcp-nominatim

tools.name: search_address
tools.description: Search for coordinates of an address or place name. Returns latitude, longitude, display name, and place type for matched locations.

query.description: Free-form address or place name to search for (e.g. "Eiffel Tower, Paris").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5, max 50.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Convert latitude/longitude coordinates to a human-readable address. Returns nearest address, place name, and administrative boundaries.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Get details for OpenStreetMap locations by ID (e.g., "N123456" for node, "W654321" for way, "R111" for relation). Returns coordinates, names, and metadata.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of OSM IDs with type prefix (e.g. "N123456,W654321"). N=node, W=way, R=relation.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nominatim forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nominatim pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
